Clinical experience in care for stroke & neuroscience patients and
Three years experience in teaching and/or clinical program development and coordinationdevelopment andprogram and

Acts as liaison to the community by providing stroke educational seminars and referrals.lectures, interviews and presentations to community audiences. Participates in county-wide stroke awareness and education programs. Reviews literature, research and new community practice to identify changes in practice. Serves on committeesas appropriate to provide clinical and theoretical expertise in stroke and clinical documentation Attends professional conferences related to program responsibilities.
Seeks guidance, direction, and assistance when needed. Confers with Utilization Management Physician Advisor as needed. Recognizes and utilizes appropriate lines of communication

Knowledgeable of, and responsible for, maintaining Sequoia Hospital's Joint Commission Primary Stroke certification and Get With The Guidelines requirements. Demonstrates Leadership abilities in: Human Resource management, decision-making, problem solving, critical thinking, managing multiple tasks in a dynamic environment. Program and project management skills. Consistently demonstrates positive interpersonal skills with patients, families, staff, and physicians. Demonstrates knowledge of principles and methods of excellence in clinical practice, community, hospital and departmental nursing standards, safety, security, infection control practices and protocols, regulations governing the hospital (Title 22, OBRA, Joint Commission, CMS, CDPH).

Works with the Stroke Center Medical Director on recommended changes in medical management as needed Oversees the quality metrics contracted with the teleneurology program. Develops and/or selects stroke education materials utilized for patient education and ensures that patient educational materials are appropriate for health literacy, cultural and language needs Provides for patient and family education in coordination with the nursing staff. Serves as a stroke expert and resource to all professional and medical staff. Works with the hospitals clinical educators and managers to develop educational plans and content for staff stroke education.. Provides stroke education to physicians nursing allied health personnel , and all other hospital staff.
Assists with the coordination of multidisciplinary care for stroke patients in collaboration with physicians and nursing staff.

Ensures that all stroke care is consistent with current evidence-based best practices. Initiate, coordinates or leads stroke program performance improvement initiatives including action plans and outcome evaluation.
